attributes.residual:
THE PIN'S SECOND OBJECTIVE IS REFUTED, MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. The work order predicted that the smaller residual would 'retire one of the few unproven_recolor_audit escapes'. IT DOES NOT, and the reason is a fact about the function rather than about the guard (AGENTS.md discipline 14 applied: the refusal was instrumented before being recorded). BOTH machine proofs still refuse, at the SAME site, with the SAME cause, in BOTH the 22-word and the 14-word bodies:
  verify_consistent_recolor  -> '+0x30: use of g0 does not correspond to g0 under the running renaming'
  verify_value_equality_recolor -> '+0x30: use of g0 is not value-equal to g0'
THE MECHANISM, read off the aligned raw words. Our stream: +0x20 `lwz r5,4(r3)` (node), +0x28 `addi r0,r3,@l` (the &lbl_8031EB00 entries base), +0x30 `mr r31,r0` -- so OUR r0 holds the ENTRIES BASE and is copied to r31. Retail: +0x20 `lwz r0,4(r3)` (node), +0x28 `addi r29,r3,@l` (entries base parked in r29), +0x30 `mr r3,r0` -- so RETAIL's r0 holds the NODE and is copied to r3. The two streams read DIFFERENT VALUES out of g0 at the same offset. That is a value-to-register ASSIGNMENT difference, not a renaming, so no bijective map and no value-equality relation can contain the required pair -- which here is the DEGENERATE g0->g0, the one substitution a declaration cannot manufacture. Both refusals are CORRECT and the escape is REQUIRED.
WHAT WAS BANKED INSTEAD, and it is the real prize: the UNPROVEN SURFACE SHRANK 22 -> 14 WORDS (36% smaller, matching the 44 -> 28 real), and the audit note was rewritten from a stale description (it named r3/r29, registers this body no longer uses) to the measured +0x30 mechanism above, with both refusal messages quoted verbatim so a future lane can screen it without rebuilding.
STANDING FINDING FOR THE NEXT LANE: the refusal SITE (+0x30) and MESSAGE are INVARIANT across the entire 120-permutation declaration-order space -- the 22-word body and the 14-word body refuse identically. Combined with CV's archive-exhaustion law that is strong evidence the +0x30 collision is allocator state with no source or compiler lever, and the remaining honest paths are a composed permute+recolor model or leaving the (now much smaller) audited escape in place. Do NOT re-run a declaration-order or compiler/flag sweep on it.
